name: Pimavanserin
summary: Pimavanserin, sold under the brand name Nuplazid, is an atypical antipsychotic which is approved for the treatment of Parkinson's disease psychosis. It is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Pimavanserin acts as a selective inverse agonist or antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor. It is also an antagonist or inverse agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor to a lesser extent.

uses.text: Pimavanserin, sold under the brand name Nuplazid, is an atypical antipsychotic which is approved for the treatment of Parkinson's disease psychosis. Pimavanserin was first approved for medical use in 2016. It was approved as a generic medication in 2024.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of pimavanserin include peripheral edema and confusion.

summaryZh: 匹莫范色林是一種非典型抗精神病藥物，被批准用於治療帕金森氏病，也正在研究用於治療阿爾茨海默病精神病、精神分裂症、躁動和重度抑鬱症。 與其他抗精神病藥不同，匹莫范色林不是多巴胺受體拮抗劑。

fact.en: Approved in 2016, it was the first medicine for the hallucinations of Parkinson's disease, and it works without blocking dopamine at all, which matters because dopamine blockers make Parkinson's worse.
fact.zh: 它在 2016 年獲准上市，是第一個治療帕金森氏症幻覺的藥物。它完全不阻斷多巴胺，這點很重要，因為多巴胺阻斷劑會使帕金森氏症惡化。
fact.zhHans: 它在 2016 年获准上市，是第一个治疗帕金森氏症幻觉的药物。它完全不阻断多巴胺，这点很重要，因为多巴胺阻断剂会使帕金森氏症恶化。
